newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to place $315 mln in T-bills by Feb.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to place $315 mln in T-bills by Feb.

text.p: Venezuelan Central Bank officials expect to place up to 150 billion bolivars ($315 million) of treasury bills by the end of next month, leading daily El Nacional reported.

The bills, whose terms still have to be defined, will be used to pay-off the government's $3.8 billion debt with the Central Bank. They will also partially substitute for the Central Bank- backed monetary stabilization notes, called TEMs, currently used in open market operations.
Central Bank vice-president Hugo Romero said the bank would place around 300 billion bolivars ($630 million) of the bills every quarter, El Nacional reported.
The financing cost of using TEMs brought a second half loss of 37 billion bolivars ($78 million) to the Central Bank.
